purpose: Semantic-neutral rendering layer for validated canonical resumes. It formats, exports, measures layout, and validates rendered output without changing career truth.

public_api.style: Functions may be synchronous or asynchronous. Render functions return RenderResult DTOs; layout functions return LayoutReport DTOs; validation functions return RenderValidationReport DTOs.

status_vocabulary.unsupported_semantics: unsupported means the requested format or artifact kind is not supported under the current renderer policy, template targets, or MVP runtime; unsupported results must carry a machine-readable reason.
status_vocabulary.ok_payload_invariant: ok means the function produced a genuine output payload. Artifact results that claim a media_type must include bytes whose container/header matches that media_type; markdown ok results are text content with no media_type claim.
status_vocabulary.required_reduction_unit: required_reduction and requiredReduction are integer character counts, not page deltas.

status_table.condition: resume validates as RenderableResume, template validates, and markdown text content is produced without changing semantic content.
resume or template validation fails, returning a typed validation/render error without traceback leakage.

resume validates as RenderableResume, template validates, and a DOCX artifact is produced with media_type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document and valid DOCX zip bytes.
resume or template validation fails, returning a typed validation/render error without traceback leakage.
specified for a future real PDF runtime only: template targets PDF and the renderer emits actual PDF bytes with media_type application/pdf.
template omits format_targets, excludes pdf, or targets pdf while the MVP runtime has no PDF renderer.
resume or template validation fails before PDF policy evaluation, returning a typed validation/render error without traceback leakage.
estimated page count is less than or equal to target_pages and required_reduction/requiredReduction are 0 character counts.
estimated page count exceeds target_pages and required_reduction/requiredReduction are positive integer character counts with offending_sections.
resume or template validation fails, including invalid target_pages, returning a typed validation error.
readable text is extracted and no missing sections, unsupported characters, empty output, artifact parse-back gaps, or semantic differences are found.
readable text is extracted but renderer-specific validation warnings are present.
specified for RKIT-I-0032: pdf-kind artifacts under MVP parse-back policy must return unsupported instead of pass/fail/error.
input lacks readable text or a recognized format/artifact payload, returning a typed validation error.

surfaces.name: renderMarkdown
surfaces.description: Render a validated canonical resume to Markdown/text while preserving semantic content, section order, titles, dates, skill names, and bullet meaning.

output_contract.ok_condition: Produces markdown text content; no media_type is claimed for markdown text results.

surfaces.name: renderDocx
surfaces.description: Render a validated canonical resume to DOCX while preserving semantic content and reporting template version metadata.

output_contract.ok_condition: Produces an artifact with DOCX media_type and valid DOCX zip bytes.

surfaces.name: renderPdf
surfaces.description: Render a PDF artifact when the environment and template support it. Unsupported PDF output must be reported explicitly without breaking non-PDF release targets when policy allows.

output_contract.ok_condition: Future-only until a PDF runtime exists: ok requires an artifact with media_type application/pdf and bytes beginning with %PDF.

surfaces.name: measureLayout
surfaces.description: Estimate pages and report layout pressure. Overflow returns constraints; renderer must not silently shorten content to fit.

output_contract.required_reduction_unit_description: required_reduction and requiredReduction are integer character counts required to fit target_pages, never a page-count delta.

surfaces.name: validateRenderedOutput
surfaces.description: Validate rendered artifacts with parse-back/ATS checks and report missing text, unsupported characters, missing headings, unreadable output, or material semantic loss.

output_contract.unsupported_condition: Specified for RKIT-I-0032 only: pdf-kind artifacts under MVP parse-back policy return unsupported with a machine-readable reason; implemented=false in status_vocabulary until that behavior lands.
